nodes.description: owner address of BotProtected/Ionx; written from tx.origin in the Ionx constructor and used for privileged access checks in delegate() and list().

wrapped BNB token address used to derive the pair address.
constant public token decimals (18).

edges.reason: Ionx constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making the deployer EOA the privileged owner through tx.origin.
constructor sets allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1), giving the origin account unlimited allowance.
tx.origin is read inside the Ionx constructor to establish ownership.

approve writes the allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
list requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting balances and adding liquidity.

reference ERC20.transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance deduction.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the delegate authorization check.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the list authorization check.

balanceOf[_to] is read and then incremented with unchecked arithmetic.
